segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ עוֹשִׂין מַעֲקֶה לַגַּג וְלַמִּרְפֶּסֶת מַעֲשֵׂה הֶדְיוֹט, אֲבָל לֹא מַעֲשֵׂה אוּמָּן. שָׁפִין אֶת הַסְּדָקִין וּמַעֲגִילִין אוֹתָן בַּמַּעֲגִילָה, בַּיָּד וּבָרֶגֶל אֲבָל לֹא בְּמַחְלָצַיִם.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One may construct a railing for a roof or a balcony» if it is done in a nonprofessional manner, as «the work of a layman, but not» if it is done skillfully, as «the work of a craftsman. One may plaster the cracks» in an oven «and roll over them with a roller,» a wooden tool used to smooth out clay, «with a hand or a foot, but not with a presser,» a tool that is specially designed for this task.

segments.he: הַצִּיר וְהַצִּינּוֹר וְהַקּוֹרָה וְהַמַּנְעוּל וְהַמַּפְתֵּחַ שֶׁנִּשְׁבְּרוּ — מְתַקְּנָן בַּמּוֹעֵד, וּבִלְבַד שֶׁלֹּא יִתְכַּוֵּין לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלַאכְתּוֹ בַּמּוֹעֵד.
segments.en: With regard to «the hinge» of a door, «and the cylinder» of the hinge, «and the» cross «beam» that holds the door, «and a lock and a key that broke, one may fix them on» the intermediate days of «a Festival» as these items are essential for the Festival and their repair cannot be delayed. This is permitted, «provided that he does not intend» ahead of time «to do his labor on the Festival» and delay it until that time.

segments.he: וְכׇל כְּבָשִׁין שֶׁהוּא יָכוֹל לֶאֱכוֹל מֵהֶן בַּמּוֹעֵד כּוֹבְשָׁן.
segments.en: «And» with regard to «all preserved food from which one can eat on the Festival,» since they become ready to be eaten in a short amount of time, «he» may «preserve them» on the intermediate days of a Festival.

moves.summary: fixing broken hinges, beams, locks and keys
preserving food edible on the Festival

positions.claim: layman's railings permitted, craftsman's forbidden; cracks plastered by hand or foot but not with a presser; broken hinges/locks may be fixed unless deliberately left for the Festival; preserves edible on the Festival may be made
